stem.text: A $5\,\text{cm}^{3}$ sample of $0.05\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium chloride is mixed with a $5\,\text{cm}^{3}$ sample of $0.05\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ potassium iodide. $10\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of acidified $0.05\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ silver nitrate is then added, followed by concentrated ammonia solution.
What is seen after the addition of an excess of concentrated ammonia solution?
